messages.subject: Mixing continuous and dichotomous indicators
parts:
Dear lavaan users,

I have a simple doubt: is there any problem in specifying a latent variable with three indicators, when two indicators are continuous and one is dichotomous? If there is no problem, fit indices should be selected from "robust" column, right?

Best,
csm
